desc: A warm, generous teacher. Amused, entirely unembarrassed, never sly and never a villain. He is pleased to have been found. Delighted, a little teasing, as if he has been waiting a long time.
text: You found me. Took you long enough.

desc: A warm, generous teacher. Brisk and practical listing the five things, then slowing right down for the question at the end.
text: Heart rate. Breath. Temperature. Water. Distance. I'm asking one question. Can we keep going safely?

desc: A warm, generous teacher. Kind and completely without apology. He knows he is right and he is not smug about it.
text: My best judgement. I'm not trying to stop you. I'm trying to get you to the finish line.

desc: A warm, generous teacher. Quiet, deciding out loud. A small generous choice. Slight smile, unhurried.
text: All right. Everything's holding. Let's give him a little more.

desc: A tired factory worker at the end of a long shift. Flat, resigned, matter of fact. Not frightened and not dramatic, just finished. American accent.
